tests.title: redirects to the Dashboard and establishes an active session
shows the generic Invalid credentials message and stays on the login page
shows Required under Username only and does not authenticate
shows Required under Password only and clears once valid input is entered
password field is type=password and never renders plaintext, even after re-render
logout returns to login page and the old session no longer grants dashboard access
back navigation lands on login and the dashboard document is sent with no-store/no-cache
unauthenticated visitor to /dashboard/index is redirected to login with no protected content
rejects the SQL injection payload with no auth bypass and no DB error disclosure
unknown username and wrong password produce the identical generic message
keyboard focus order, accessible names, Enter submission and accessible validation
login and dashboard redirect stay within the 2s threshold across repeated runs
